adopt: Take a lease on a file before you edit it in a shared checkout.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
Several agents editing one worktree silently sweep each other's work; a diff tells you WHAT changed but not who meant it or whether they were mid-edit.

Install
pip install awgit

Commands
  awgit

Quick start
  pip install awgit
  awgit init # verify the actor, install the capture hooks

Docs
https://aitherium.github.io/awgit/
synopsis: Semantic version control on top of git
